identity.author: ShangguanXi and contributors
identity.description: An unofficial Bedrock Edition port of the Java mod Farmer's Delight (by Vectorwing), reproducing its cooking mechanics, crops, and kitchen blocks.

constraints: GPL-3.0 is copyleft: redistributed derivatives of the licensed code must remain GPL-3.0 and disclose source

The port's own README states the original Java Farmer's Delight mod is MIT-licensed, which the author cites as permission to port it; this entry evaluates only the Bedrock port repository's own GPL-3.0 grant, not the upstream Java mod

scripts: JavaScript/TypeScript addon scripts (repository is ~50% JavaScript, ~50% TypeScript)

customCapabilities.parity_goal: reproduces the Java Farmer's Delight feature set (crops, cooking pot recipes, cutting board tool interactions) as closely as possible per the README

manifestEvidence: README: unofficial Bedrock port of Farmer's Delight, MIT-licensed upstream cited as porting permission
scriptEvidence: Repository language split: ~50% JavaScript, ~50% TypeScript (Script API addon)

strongIndicators: 12 tagged GitHub releases, 21 stars, 7 forks, 6 contributors, actively updated (latest commit ~2 months old)
Published GPL-3.0 LICENSE.txt and explicit upstream MIT-license permission citation
Multi-language localization (6 languages) and public docs/ folder
weakIndicators: Unofficial, community-maintained port; behavior may diverge from the Java original
Specific block/item/recipe internals were not independently inspected in this review; only README/release-level facts were used
gaps: No script- or component-level inspection was performed; capability list is derived from the mod's documented purpose, not verified pack internals

implementationFacts.implementationPattern: Script API-driven kitchen/cooking machine set (cooking pot, cutting board, stove, skillet) plus farming crop additions, aiming for feature parity with the Java Farmer's Delight mod
limitations: Unofficial port; some mechanics may be simplified or diverge from the Java version
Capability facts here are description-level; not verified against actual pack source
transferSemantics: Manual player-driven item insertion/interaction with kitchen blocks

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-09-11 against the public README, root file listing (LICENSE.txt), and release/contributor history.

Replaces an earlier hand-crafted, non-GitHub 'Farmer's Delight Bedrock (Unofficial)' file a user supplied locally, which claimed CurseForge-only admissibility while simultaneously disallowing redistribution — that file was rejected, not ingested.
No FarmersDelightBedrock source code was copied into Hydraulic; only README/release-level capability descriptions were recorded.
